package orgs

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"example.test/sysapp/internal/domain"
	models "example.test/sysapp/internal/models/orgs"
	rules "example.test/sysapp/internal/rules/orgs"
	"example.test/sysapp/internal/scope"
)

// Provision creates the organization for the verified subject. The tenant
// identifier is minted by generated code; the body cannot choose it.
func Provision(
	ctx context.Context,
	p scope.Provisioning,
	ports ProvisionPorts,
	in models.ProvisionRequest,
) (models.Org, error) {
	if !rules.ValidSlug(in.Slug) || !rules.ValidName(in.Name) {
		return models.Org{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: signup", domain.ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	org, err := ports.Tenants.Provision(ctx, p, in)
	if errors.Is(err, rules.ErrSlugTaken) {
		return models.Org{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}

	return org, err
}
